name: index_repository
description: Index a repository. full/moderate add semantics; fast omits them; cross-repo-intelligence links services. Reports coverage gaps.

mode.description: full: all+semantic; moderate: filtered+semantic; fast: filtered only; cross-repo-intelligence: link services.

name.description: Name override; Non-ASCII bytes are encoded; unsafe characters normalized.

name: search_graph
description: Find symbols via BM25 query, regex name/qn filters, or semantic_query. Rows keep qn/file/lines and in/out over CALLS/USAGE/CALL_REFERENCE/INHERITS/IMPLEMENTS.

active_horizons.description: Optional active horizon IDs for federated speculative overlay

name: query_graph
description: Read-only Cypher for multi-hop, aggregation, complexity, or cross-service analysis. Default: 200 visible rows with exact/lower-bound totals and truncation; continue safely with next_cursor. graph=missed is a file tree of flagged coverage gaps; absence is not proof of completeness. Use get_graph_schema(diagnostics=full) for properties.

active_horizons.description: Optional active horizon IDs for federated speculative overlay

graph.description: code graph (default) or missed coverage-gap file tree.

max_rows.description: Visible rows (default 200; max 99998); 0 uses the legacy maximum. Evaluation is unchanged.

offset.description: Live compatibility paging; cannot be combined with cursor.

cursor.description: Snapshot continuation; keep query/project/graph. Format, budget, and max_rows may change.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Rows stay whole.

format.description: tree may use local @N+suffix prefix refs; json uses direct strings.

name: trace_path
description: Trace callers/callees, data flow, or cross-service paths. Defaults exclude tests and resolver evidence. Rows keep qn/hop with explicit totals, relations, and continuations.

active_horizons.description: Optional active horizon IDs for federated speculative overlay

limit.description: Rows/page; gte flags the 5000-node engine ceiling.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Evidence/args yield before nearest graph rows.

cursor.description: Pass next/next_cursor with traversal args unchanged; budget may increase.

mode.description: calls, argument-aware data_flow, or service edges.

format.description: tree chooses smaller complete direct/grouped output; json uses stable grouped tables.

name: get_code_snippet
description: Read a search_graph symbol. auto bounds source and outlines large containers; full restores up to 500 lines. Source/outline pages continue; coverage_note marks gaps.

source_mode.description: auto outlines 200+ line containers; full returns source; outline lists members.

max_output_tokens.description: auto/outline sizing hint (default 2500), hard ceiling 4 UTF-8 bytes/token. Lines stay whole; explicit full is uncapped unless set.

name: get_file_outline
description: Declaration outline of one exact repository-relative file: optional exact label filter, source order, exact total/offset/limit paging; file/folder/container nodes excluded.

name: get_graph_schema
description: Get node-label and edge-type counts. diagnostics=full also lists queryable properties.

name: compare_graphs
description: Compare two indexed snapshots: deterministic target-only additions and base-only removals of stable node/edge identities; each set capped by limit and a 512 KiB budget with exact totals and truncation reasons.

name: get_architecture
description: Compact counts, languages, packages, entry points. Request structure, dependencies, routes, hotspots, boundaries, layers, clusters, cycles, or file_tree; path scopes a directory.

aspects.description: all=everything; overview=compact except file_tree; omitted=languages/packages/entry_points; cycles is opt-in.

name: search_code
description: Graph-ranked text search: compact symbols, full bounded source, or file paths.

raw_content_offset.description: Raw-line byte offset; omit for match-centered preview.

name: list_projects
description: List projects with stable paging. Identity is lean; stats adds graph sizes.

include_details.description: Alias for detail=stats: include branch, node/edge counts and database size. Slower.

metadata_only.description: Compatibility: omit counts, size, and branch.

name: delete_project
description: Delete a project from the index

name: index_status
description: Project readiness, counts, root, and coverage gaps. diagnostics adds coverage rows; verbose adds Git paths. Best-effort only; verify cited paths with check_index_coverage.

verbose.description: Add worktree/shadow Git paths for index-location debugging.

diagnostics.description: Coverage rows: counts, five samples, or up to 500.

name: check_index_coverage
description: Best-effort exact-path/scope coverage and freshness, paged separately. full diagnostics adds raw detail. Clean is not proof of completeness.

name: detect_changes
description: Map a Git diff to files and impact. Page with snapshot cursors.

max_output_tokens.description: Sizing hint; hard ceiling is 4 UTF-8 bytes/token.

name: manage_adr
description: Outline an ADR by default; get reads it; update replaces it

mode.description: outline pages headings; get reads; update replaces the whole document; set_sections rewrites only the named sections and leaves every other byte untouched (an identical repeated write is byte-identical, so retrying is safe); sections is legacy.

section_updates.description: set_sections: section name -> new body. Any heading name works; names match exactly, including case.

name: ingest_traces
description: Validate and count traces; graph edge creation is not implemented

name: create_horizon
description: Create or update an ephemeral cognitive horizon overlay with speculative nodes and virtual edges

project.description: Project name or path to associate with this horizon

name: promote_horizon
description: Validate Two-Tier anchors and admit a horizon into the base graph

horizon_id.description: Identifier of the horizon to promote

anchors.description: Optional Two-Tier anchors for drift validation

name: sync_horizon_spec
description: Sync and compile tactical specification markdown into an ephemeral horizon overlay

file_path.description: Path of the markdown specification file

content.description: Optional markdown text content (reads from file_path on disk if omitted)

name: validate_scope_horizon
description: Validate scope adjacency and detect isolated dangling nodes in a horizon overlay

horizon_id.description: Identifier of the horizon to validate

strict_connectivity.description: Whether dangling nodes without edges fail validation (default true)

name: union_session_open
description: Open a bounded Union session; optional host/context/grounding fields bind it to the E01 repository mutation gate

based_on_seq.description: Belief sequence or generation hash this session is grounded upon

host.description: Host that owns the work context

context_id.description: Host-issued stable thread or conversation ID

intent_key.description: Change intent authorized by this session

intent_scope.description: Exact path and operation pairs this session may write

name: union_session_get
description: Query the live state of an open session horizon

name: union_session_close
description: Close a session horizon, emitting a typed closure event and destroying speculative content

horizon_id.description: Identifier of the session horizon to close

name: union_record_action
description: Authorize and record a skill action through the effect-class gateway

action_name.description: Name of the action being invoked

auth_id.description: Scoped operator authorization ID (required for IRREVERSIBLE)

name: classify_activity
description: Classify incoming intent into CONSULTATIVE (local project) or SPECIALTY (normative craft / tradition required)

intent.description: The user intent, prompt, or task description

name: validate_provenance
description: Validate specialty judgment provenance (requires active canon citation or declared invention with rationale)

theme_id.description: Governing craft theme ID for canon citation

declared_invention.description: True if novel craft is explicitly declared

name: theme_lookup
description: Lookup a Thematic Knowledge Base in the registry (surfaces ABSENT as a first-class state)

name: theme_register
description: Register or catalog a Thematic Knowledge Base

name: binding_claim
description: Declare or query a project binding to a craft theme (DEVE normative or PODE consulted)

binding_scope.description: Scope of code or architecture affected

name: founding_propose
description: Propose a new Thematic Knowledge Base from declared inventions harvested during closure sweep

rationale.description: Why this craft convention warrants formalization

name: founding_decide
description: Operator decision on a founding proposal (accept into DRAFT theme or decline)

operator_accepted.description: True to accept proposal into DRAFT, false to decline

decided_by.description: Identity of operator deciding the proposal (e.g. 'operator')

is_agent_autonomous.description: True if caller is an agent (autonomous founding forbidden)

name: contest_verify
description: Submit a typed contestation with evidence against a target claim (caller-blind verification)

target_horizon.description: Target session horizon ID containing the claim

name: union_claim_capture
description: Capture a conversational claim into a session horizon as PROPOSED (Scope C03)

predicate.description: Single self-contained declarative sentence ending with period

name: union_claim_resolve
description: Assign a mandatory destination to a conversational claim before session closure (Scope C03)

owner_or_reason.description: Owner for OPEN_QUESTION or typed reason for DISCARDED (e.g. exploration, dead_end)

validator_identity.description: Operator identity if validating DECISION/OPEN_QUESTION intent
